verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Bitbucket hosts Git repositories: Git is a repo option at creation (comm-3), old repos must be re-imported using Git (comm-12), and commits carry issue keys (docs-1). Community users describe read-only deploy keys attachable to multiple repos (comm-15), which implies key-based (SSH) Git access. However, no first-party doc explicitly describes cloning, pulling or pushing with standard Git clients over HTTPS or SSH. Missing for 10: explicit first-party docs on HTTPS and SSH clone/push URLs, SSH key and HTTPS credential setup, and hands-on corroboration of standard Git client interoperability.
